description: List sent messages that have not been read by one or more recipients. Reads from local cache. Returns `complete` describing whether every sent message was scanned. An empty SENT cache that is not verified-fresh is REFUSED (result:"UNVERIFIED_EMPTY") rather than reported as "nothing sent"; pass autoRefresh:true to sync and answer instead.

autoRefresh.description: If the result comes back EMPTY from a cache that is not verified-fresh, sync the backing folders first and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing. Defaults to the OFW_AUTO_REFRESH env var (false unless set), in which case the call refuses with result:"UNVERIFIED_EMPTY" and names the remedy. Costs OFW requests when it fires.

name: ofw_get_unread_sent
